title: Schedule of Trend Review, Sequence Tuning and Operator Training — Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Schedule of Trend Review, Sequence Tuning and Operator Training — Building Automation Service Plans

The Building Automation Service Plans carry, per tier, a trend review frequency, a number of business days after the review period closes by which the trend report is delivered, a number of sequence tuning visits included per plan year and a number of operator training hours included per plan year.

| Tier | Trend review frequency | Trend report delivered within (business days after period close) | Sequence tuning visits per plan year | Operator training hours per plan year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | none | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | none | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | annual | 15 | 0 | 2 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | semiannual | 10 | 1 | 4 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | quarterly | 10 | 2 | 8 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | monthly | 5 | 4 | 24 |

Notes:

1. Where the trend review frequency is none, no trend data is reviewed or reported and the report delivery figure is 0 business days.
2. Sequence tuning visits are included only from the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan upward; operator training hours from the Scheduled Controls Service Plan upward.
3. Illustration (hypothetical): a Remote Optimization Plan site has its trend data reviewed each quarter, with the report delivered within 10 business days after the quarter closes, and holds 2 tuning visits and 8 training hours for the plan year.
